info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Billing Inquiry API
info.description: The Corporate Billing Inquiry API enables users to retrieve detailed billing information for corporate accounts. It provides essential insights into billing summaries, transaction histories, and payment statuses, helping businesses manage their financial obligations effectively. Typical consumers of this API include finance departments, accounting software integrations, and corporate clients seeking transparency in their billing processes. By facilitating access to vital billing data, this API supports timely decision-making and enhances overall financial management capabilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the corporate billing details associated with their enterprise account, including invoices and payment history.
